headline: Meta delays new business terms after backlash over AI content scraping
summary: Meta revised and then delayed enforcement of new business terms, after backlash over language that could let it scrape content from sites linked to businesses on its platforms, including news publishers, to train AI. A spokesperson said the revisions don't change how Meta crawls the web; legal experts say the changes still fall short. Outlets differ on whether the targeted content is framed as news sites' or business accounts'.
